execution_profile.host_identity: The same physical host and immutable image for every stack in a cohort; exact CPU model/OS/kernel/BIOS, clocks and dependencies must be sealed in the run manifest before any participant timing.
execution_profile.process_memory_limit: Per-case cap, maximum 16 GiB including SDK-owned child processes.
execution_profile.smt: Do not share the measured physical core with an active sibling; record the actual SMT policy.
execution_profile.stochastic_seed_rule: Take first 8 bytes of SHA256("sdkbench-first-wave:0.1-candidate-1:<instance>:<block>:<context>") modulo 2**32; block is 0..9; context is 0-based fixture order. Same integers requested of participants, not the same RNG stream.

content.qualification: Later held-out policy-cost qualification; original before-merge timing requirement was unmet. Local event record, not independent timestamp attestation.

scope: Source selection published in PR #10 before a single hosted dispatch. Initial sandbox transport failed, run history confirmed no new run, then one network-enabled dispatch succeeded. No worker rerun or entropy redraw. Local receipts are not independent timestamp attestations.
